details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept: its preinstall hook (node preinstall.js) reads the installer's hostname, sanitizes it to alphanumeric characters plus dashes, truncates it to 60 characters, and folds it into a DNS lookup of <hostname>.ngp-ui.script-test-cleanup.oob.jr0ch17[.]com via dns.resolve(). No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted — the only data leaving the host is the machine hostname carried in the DNS label. The package's index.js is an inert empty export and its manifest describes it as security research. Callback domain: ngp-ui.script-test-cleanup.oob.jr0ch17[.]com (queried as <hostname>.ngp-ui.script-test-cleanup.oob.jr0ch17[.]com).
